about.title: Adelanto Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: San Bernardino County records show traffic deaths happen on Adelanto's roads every year, including 5 in the most recent reporting period, often along corridors like Rt 395, Bellflower Street, and Air Expwy. For the families left behind, the grief is immediate, but California law also sets a clock: a wrongful death claim generally must be filed within two years of the date of death, sooner if a government entity is involved. We handle wrongful death cases for surviving spouses, domestic partners, children, and other eligible heirs. An attorney on our team can walk through who qualifies to bring a claim, what losses may be recoverable, and how the process typically unfolds from here.

items.title: Understanding Who Can File
items.desc: California limits standing in wrongful death cases to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, with other dependents or heirs eligible under certain circumstances. We can clarify where you and your family fit before any claim moves forward.

items.title: Awareness of the Filing Deadline
items.desc: Wrongful death claims generally must be filed within two years of the date of death, though claims against a government agency carry a much shorter window. Because Adelanto's roads include state highways, that distinction can matter, and it's worth confirming early.

items.title: Clarity on What Losses May Be Recoverable
items.desc: California law allows families to pursue costs like funeral and burial expenses, lost financial support, and the loss of a loved one's love, companionship, and guidance. We can help you understand how these categories may apply to your specific situation.

items.question: How is a wrongful death claim different from a criminal case against the at-fault driver?
items.answer: A wrongful death claim is a separate civil action pursued by the family, independent of any criminal charges the state might file against the driver. The two proceedings have different purposes, different burdens of proof, and can move on entirely different timelines. One outcome doesn't determine the other.

items.question: Does it matter that the crash happened on a highway like Rt 395 instead of a city street?
items.answer: It can. If a state or local government agency's road design, signage, or maintenance played a role, claims against a public entity often carry a much shorter filing deadline than the standard two years. We can help determine whether that shorter window applies to your family's situation.

items.question: What if I'm not sure whether I qualify to file a claim?
items.answer: California law prioritizes a spouse, domestic partner, and children as the first in line to bring a wrongful death claim, but other dependents or heirs may also have standing depending on the family structure. This isn't always straightforward to sort out alone. Our team can review your circumstances and explain where you stand.
